subject: Action needed: TMN Hermes has lost its independent watchdog
ticket_title: TMN Hermes watchdog coverage lost — reported by R2H
runbook: The independent watchdog for TMN Hermes on neb-ops-gcp stopped receiving fresh heartbeats.
Check the independent observer on the R2H VM:
The observer reports loss of watchdog heartbeat coverage; Codex sign-in failures are reported by the TMN health check itself.
context_note: This is a dedicated observer process on the separate R2H Hermes VM (Tailscale peer r2h-observer, 100.85.162.108).
It watches only neb-ops-gcp and cannot inspect Codex credentials or restart Hermes gateways.
TMN monitors this heartbeat but has no SSH repair access to the independent observer.
The observer sends its alerts through the R2H host's configured Telegram bot and private chat.
